name: cairn-lang
description: Language support for Cairn (.crn) — a Minecraft build description language.

cairn.serverPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the `cairn-lsp` binary. Leave empty to look up `cairn-lsp` on `PATH`. Install the binary from the [GitHub release](https://github.com/kage1020/Cairn/releases) matching your `cairn` CLI version. Reload the window after changing this to apply the new server.

enumDescriptions: Pin no edition: diagnostics are what `cairn check` reports.
cairn.edition.markdownDescription: The edition diagnostics are checked for, as `cairn check --edition` checks it: its theme variants and `@edition` guards. Leave empty to pin none.

cairn.target.markdownDescription: The version of `cairn.edition` diagnostics are checked against, as `cairn compile --target` checks it: a version the edition ships, or `latest`. Block ids and states are checked against its tables, and the file's `@requires` floors hold it (`E_VERSION_CAP`). Needs `cairn.edition`. Leave empty to pin the edition alone.

cairn.trace.server.description: Trace communication between VS Code and the Cairn language server in the Output panel.

scripts.test: pnpm build && pnpm build:test && node --test --test-timeout=180000 --test-force-exit out/test/extension.test.js
scripts.package: pnpm check && pnpm build:prod && vsce package --no-dependencies
